title: Metric Identity
description: The identity of one metric: a standard or vendor metric, discriminated by `scope`, with an optional qualifier. Rows join on `(scope, metric_id, qualifier)`.

scope.description: Standard metric from the closed `available-metric.json` enum.

qualifier.description: Disambiguator — same shape as `committed_metrics.qualifier`. Carry `viewability_standard` for MRC vs GroupM viewability feedback; `completion_source` for seller- vs vendor-attested completion feedback; `attribution_methodology` and `attribution_window` for outcome-metric feedback (the buyer pinning a specific methodology or window when the feedback is methodology-sensitive). Closed (`additionalProperties: false`), because consumers join on the key set; new keys ship in a major release.

scope.description: Vendor-defined metric, identified by the tuple `(vendor, metric_id)`.

vendor.description: Vendor that defines and computes this metric. Same identity discipline as `vendor_metric_value.vendor` and `committed_metrics` vendor-scope entries. Distinct from the row-level `vendor` field at the top of `performance-feedback`, which identifies the *source* of the feedback (the party producing it); this nested vendor identifies the *vendor that defines the metric* (which may or may not be the same party). Typically the same when third-party verification reports its own metric; can differ when a buyer's MMM tool reports on a separately-defined vendor metric.

metric_id.description: Identifier for the metric within the vendor's vocabulary.

qualifier.description: Optional disambiguator mirroring the vendor-scope qualifier on `committed_metrics` — same closed key set as standard-scope entries.
